text:
Marta: Quick sync — I ran ~1k-trace replay on the new kernel selector branch. Seeing weird tail latency + KV cache miss rates.
Ben: What's the diff vs main? numbers?
Marta: 95p up 12%, 99p up 18%. KV cold miss rate 4.8% vs baseline 1.1%.
Carla: Did you enable the new batch heuristic? Could be changing prefix grouping.
Marta: Yes, batch-heuristic=cohort-reserve=true. Command I used:
```bash
./replay-run --trace=prod-2026-03-12 --anon=sha256 --sample=0.03 --deterministic --kernel=sel-v2 --batch-config=cohort
```
Daphne: Can you paste the anonymization pipeline? need to confirm we didn't accidentally strip KV keys.
Marta: anon config: ```yaml
anon:
  strategy: hash-truncate
  keep_context_tokens: true
  salt: redwood-prod-salt-v3
``` 
Ben: If salt changed that would explain hash mismatches but not cache miss rate.
Erik: Did you replay with the same request ordering as prod? the sampler in harness reorders by length by default.
Marta: I used chronological order (no resort). sample code snippet:
```py
sampler = TraceSampler(seed=42, method='chronological', fraction=0.03)
``` 
Carla: For parity we need token-level hash diffs + logprob scatter plots. Can you export a small delta set?
Marta: Uploading 250-sample parity dump to GCS: gs://redwood-replay-dumps/2938401111/delta.tar.gz
deploy-bot: CI replay pipeline started: https://ci.redwood.internal/teams/infra/pipelines/replay/2938401111 :rocket:
Daphne: Quick checklist:
- confirm anon salt + method
- deterministic seed
- KV cache warmup (prefetch window)
- disable cohort-reserve batch heuristic
- run N=3 repeats
Ben: Also compare kernel selectors: sel-v1 vs sel-v2 with same batch config.
Marta: Running sel-v1 now. ETA ~20m.
Erik: For metrics, use these parity checks:
1) output-length distribution
2) token-level logprob MAE
3) per-request token-output hash equality
4) latency quantiles (p50, p95, p99)
Carla: If we can't reach parity, next step is micro-trace replay on a single request that shows divergence and step through KV state with logging.
Marta: Noted. I'll run the matrix: {anon_variant: [v2,v3], kernel: [sel-v1,sel-v2], batch: [cohort,seq]} x 3 repeats.
Daphne: Add a column for "KV miss delta" and "warmup time" in the spreadsheet. I'll create it.
Daphne: https://docs.redwood.internal/spreadsheets/replay-ops/2938401111 :spiral_calendar:
Ben: Thanks — tagging @eng-sre in case we need infra increases for burst runners.
Carla: :thumbsup: keep notes brief in dump README so we can triage quickly.
Marta: Will do, I'll drop a short README with command lines and envs inside the GCS bundle.
Ben: Great. LMK when sel-v1 results are up.
Marta: sel-v1 run finished: p95 delta -0.3% vs baseline, KV cold miss 1.2% — looks like sel-v2 is culprit. Uploading logs.
Erik: Nice. Next steps: bisect sel-v2 change set, run microbenchmark on the kernel's kernel-selection hot paths and KV prefetch heuristics.
Marta: Starting bisect. I'll post updates here. :eyes:
